clues.it: Giada era accanto a una cuccetta, a nord di Tea e in Cambusa.
clues.en: Giada was beside a bunk, north of Tea and in the Galley.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 6ª colonna, accanto a un'ancora e in una stanza diversa da Paolo.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 6th column, beside an anchor and in a different room from Paolo.

clues.it: Dario era nella 5ª colonna, nella 3ª riga e accanto a una cassa o a uno scaffale.
clues.en: Dario was in the 5th column, in the 3rd row and beside a crate or a shelf.

clues.it: Nino era nella 2ª colonna, ma non era accanto a una rete.
clues.en: Nino was in the 2nd column, but was not beside a net.

clues.it: Rosa era in una stanza diversa da Vito e in Stiva.
clues.en: Rosa was in a different room from Vito and in the Hold.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Tea era nella 4ª colonna, ma non era accanto a uno scaffale né a una cuccetta.
clues.en: Tea was in the 4th column, but was not beside a shelf nor a bunk.

clues.it: Vito era a ovest di Tea e in Cabina.
clues.en: Vito was west of Tea and in the Cabin.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 9ª riga e in Stiva, ma non era accanto a una cuccetta.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 9th row and in the Hold, but was not beside a bunk.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Fabio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 6th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Paolo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 9ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Paolo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 9th, column 9th.

steps.it: Vito può stare solo nella 3ª colonna.
steps.en: Vito can only be in the 3rd column.

steps.it: Dario può stare solo nella 3ª riga: escludendola, a Giada resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Dario can only be in the 3rd row: ruling it out leaves Giada a single square: row 1st, column 8th.

steps.it: Tea può stare solo nella 7ª riga.
steps.en: Tea can only be in the 7th row.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 persone in Cabina» non torna senza Tea: deve stare in riga 7ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 people in the Cabin” cannot add up without Tea: they must be at row 7th, column 4th.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 accanto a una cuccetta» non torna senza Rosa: deve stare in riga 5ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 beside a bunk” cannot add up without Rosa: they must be at row 5th, column 7th.

steps.it: Escludendo la 7ª riga di Tea, a Vito resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Ruling out Tea's 7th row leaves Vito a single square: row 8th, column 3rd.

steps.it: Nino non può stare nella 6ª riga.
steps.en: Nino cannot be in the 6th row.

steps.it: Vito può stare solo nella 8ª riga: escludendola, a Nino resta una sola casella: riga 4ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Vito can only be in the 8th row: ruling it out leaves Nino a single square: row 4th, column 2nd.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «1 accanto a una sedia» non torna senza Sergio: deve stare in riga 6ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: The general clue “1 beside a chair” cannot add up without Sergio: they must be at row 6th, column 1st.
